flags.item: Fixture facts are inherited from the official capture made at 17:35Z today
flags.detail: All 50 fixture records and their per-fact source links come from the official capture committed at 17:35Z on 24 October. This build did not re-read those pages; it re-used the capture and marks every row as inherited.

flags.item: Stored Gaelic semi-final margin inputs disagreed with the official scorelines
flags.detail: The inherited record carried margins of 44 and -6 for the Galway final. The official scorelines give Maigh Cuilinn 4-26 to 0-8 (30 points) and Salthill-Knocknacarra 0-15 to 2-7 (2 points), so this desk recomputed the margins from the scores and ignored the stored values.

flags.item: Raw round-one margins were not used for Australia v Fiji
flags.detail: A two-point win over New Zealand and a 28-point win over Cook Islands cannot be compared without adjusting for the opponent, so the price comes from the evidence ladder instead and the fixture is capped at medium confidence.

flags.item: OLBG display times are US Eastern strings and have not been converted
flags.detail: OLBG prints 'Today 14:05' style times in US Eastern. They are stored exactly as shown. Where an official start time exists it is used for the fixture, and the OLBG string is kept beside it rather than converted.

flags.item: The OLBG golf hub lists no events
flags.detail: Re-read at 18:06Z today, the golf hub returned HTTP 200 and rendered 'No tips found.' The two golf fixtures are on the card with official leaderboard facts but are not asserted to be active OLBG listings.

flags.item: 4 picks are for matches that had already started when the snapshot was taken
flags.detail: 5 of the 50 fixture records had started by 2026-10-24T18:10:00Z, including one unpriced greyhound race. Started rows retain their prices and write-ups where present, but are marked as under way and kept out of the executive summary. Each row's own official link supplies its start time.

flags.item: Some fixture source links point at a news or squad-announcement page rather than a fixture list
flags.detail: Where a governing body publishes a round preview rather than a stable fixture URL, the inherited record links the article that carries the fixture time and team news. The facts on the row are the ones that page supports; a per-fixture permalink is not claimed.

flags.item: Four NBA clubs had not filed an injury report at the 1:00 PM ET deadline
flags.detail: Milwaukee, Washington, New Orleans and Golden State are recorded as NOT YET SUBMITTED. No absence is stated for those rosters, and the fields are blank rather than guessed.

flags.item: Los Angeles at New Jersey is omitted from the inherited NHL records
flags.detail: The official 24 October schedule lists 12 NHL games, including Los Angeles at New Jersey at 19:30Z. This desk inherited 10 NHL records and did not add that still-upcoming fixture at the 18:10Z snapshot. The omission is flagged rather than filled with unconfirmed teams, prices or analysis; do not call the inherited set a complete league schedule.
